changes_vs_current: Mario 64, Halo, Pokemon Red/Blue, Street Fighter II, Pac-Man, Half-Life 2, GoldenEye, Smash Melee, Portal 2, CoD4 and Fortnite drop out; Minecraft, Mario Kart 8, Super Mario Bros., Tetris and Zelda BotW/OoT stay; new are Cyberpunk 2077, Elden Ring, RE4, God of War (x2), Ghost of Tsushima, Bloodborne, Sonic, Animal Crossing NH, Marvel's Spider-Man, Mass Effect 2, Wii Sports.
confidence: low-medium. Only four people-sources exist for games and none is a general-population all-time poll: sales and YouGov are mass-market but YouGov shows only 20 titles, while Game Informer (2018) and GameRant (2026) are gamer audiences that dominate positions 1-24. Sanity check fails in places: Witcher 3 at #1, Cyberpunk 2077 at #5 (sales 40M plus GameRant #5 only), plus Bloodborne, Ghost of Tsushima, God of War Ragnarok and Mass Effect 2 are not what a typical adult names; Mario/Zelda/Tetris/Pac-Man/Pokemon-type picks are under-weighted (Tetris is #1 in sales but absent from YouGov's top 20 and GI #115; Pac-Man and Pokemon have no usable evidence beyond sales and GI 66). Two God of War entries share a franchise (alias clash on 'god of war'); a hand pass should consider dropping Ragnarok. Positions 12 and onward mostly rest on 1-2 sources, and 19-24 are tied within 0.75. Not used: a Lottoland/OnePoll 2023 fan list (FIFA #1, Mario Kart #2, Super Mario World #3, GTA #4, Pac-Man #5, Tetris #7; sponsor is UK and country is not confirmed); Game Informer Game Gauntlet 2024 (200k+ votes, Ocarina of Time champion, no ranks published, so corroboration only); Morning Consult/Interpret fan polls (franchise level, not game level).
